items.title: Claude Code 团队发布实用指南讲解 Claude Ship 的 PR 审查与守护用法
items.summary: Anthropic 推出的 Claude Ship 工具包含 Code Review、PR Steward 和 Claude Approvals 三个智能体，分别负责深度代码审查、自动修复 CI 失败与合并冲突，以及基于仓库策略文件自动批准常规改动。开发者可通过 `/code-review` 命令进行本地或云端审查，并使用 `/ship` 命令自动提交、创建 PR 并持续监控处理后续流程，其中 Code Review 已正式开放，另两项功能目前处于测试阶段。
items.why_now: Code Review 智能体已全面开放，开发者今日起即可在 GitHub 落地自动化 PR 审查流程。
items.why_now_en: Claude Ship launch creates immediate PR workflow window.
items.summary_en: Anthropic’s Claude Code team released "Claude Ship," a PR management tool featuring three agents: the fully available Code Review agent and the beta PR Steward and Claude Approvals agents. The /ship command automates the post-PR workflow by creating pull requests, running code reviews with configurable effort levels (from low to ultra), and monitoring for up to seven days to resolve CI failures, merge conflicts, and review feedback. The system includes security safeguards such as excluding sensitive configuration files from automatic commits and restricting the agents' ability to merge PRs or perform force pushes.

items.title: obra/superpowers
items.summary: Superpowers 是由 obra 开发的一套面向 Claude Code、Codex 和 Cursor 等主流编码代理的软件开发方法论与代理技能框架，支持通过官方插件市场（如 `/plugin install superpowers@claude-plugins-official`）或仓库脚本一键安装。该框架通过强制代理在编码前提取规格说明、制定遵循 TDD、YAGNI 及 DRY 原则的实施计划，并驱动子代理自主执行任务，使得代理可在数小时内保持计划一致性而不偏离。
items.why_now_en: Supports 15+ coding agents including Gemini CLI.
items.summary_en: Superpowers is an agentic skills framework and software development methodology designed for coding agents, featuring a workflow that enforces spec extraction, red/green TDD, YAGNI, and DRY principles. It supports autonomous subagent-driven development where agents execute and review tasks for up to two hours, and is installable across major platforms including Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and Devin CLI via dedicated plugin marketplaces or repository commands.

items.title: elementalsouls/Claude-BugHunter
items.summary: elementalsouls/Claude-BugHunter 是一个专为 Claude Code 设计的漏洞挖掘与红队技能包，包含 84 项技能、15 条斜杠命令以及覆盖 24 类核心漏洞的 681 个已披露报告模式。该工具通过四层架构（方法论、Web 应用狩猎、企业外围攻击、交付报告）自动加载相关技能，并集成了 Burp MCP 与 HackerOne API，支持在 DVWA、OWASP Juice Shop 等平台上进行实战测试，旨在使 AI 行为对标高级安全研究员。
items.why_now: Claude Code 插件市场开放，新发布的 Claude-BugHunter 让 AI 瞬间具备高级红队攻击能力，安全测试门槛骤降。
items.why_now_en: Fresh 2024–2026 CVE chains now embedded in AI
items.summary_en: Claude-BugHunter is a drop-in skill bundle for Claude Code that transforms the model into a senior red-team operator via 84 skills, 15 slash commands, and 681 disclosed-report patterns across 24 vulnerability classes. It features a four-layer architecture covering methodology, web application hunting, enterprise perimeter attacks on platforms like M365 and Okta, and reporting, with automatic skill loading triggered by plain English prompts. Installation is supported via a Claude Code plugin marketplace command or a standalone `pipx`/git clone copy method, optionally integrating with HackerOne for private program access.

items.title: One sandbox per run, per session or per user: isolation, cost and state trade-offs
items.summary: 沙箱隔离策略需根据负载类型在Per Run、Per Session和Per User三种粒度间选择：Per Run提供最强隔离但需通过快照机制解决重复安装依赖的成本问题，适用于一次性代码执行或CI评分；Per Session在用户会话内共享状态以支持多轮交互，但需通过计费模型优化或设置激进超时来规避空闲资源消耗；Per User长期维护独立环境虽保留完整状态，但需像管理笔记本一样处理秘密泄露和环境漂移，且严禁跨用户共享沙箱以防权限泄露。
items.summary_en: For LLM agent code execution, selecting sandbox granularity—per run, per session, or per user—determines the primary isolation trade-off: per-run offers the strongest isolation but requires snapshots to handle state, while per-session retains in-turn data at the cost of higher idle expenses and cross-turn injection risks. Per-user environments provide maximum persistence for long-lived workspaces but face the highest cost exposure and security hygiene challenges, such as credential drift. The critical security rule is that sandboxes must never be shared across users, requiring identity-verified mapping to prevent cross-tenant data leakage.

items.title: GitLab 19.6 Cuts AI Credit Costs in Half and Adds Scheduled Agent Automations
items.summary: GitLab 19.6通过优化Duo Agent Platform的任务调用机制，使GitLab Credits的使用效率提升最高达2倍，并新增支持15分钟至3个月周期的定时代理自动化功能。该版本还引入了MCP服务器治理机制，允许管理员通过Always Allow、Ask或Deny策略精细化管控Cursor及Claude Code等外部代理的访问权限。
items.why_now: GitLab 19.6 于 11 月 19 日发布，新客即日起成本减半，现成用户 12 月 18 日自动生效。
items.why_now_en: Costs halved and scheduled agents arrive Nov 19.
items.summary_en: GitLab 19.6 optimizes the Duo Agent Platform to reduce model requests per job, allowing GitLab Credits to cover up to twice as much work. The release introduces scheduled automations for Premium and Ultimate tiers, enabling agents to run on a 15-minute to three-month cadence under dedicated service accounts, alongside a new /goal command for continuous unconfirmed code generation. Additionally, the update simplifies automated security triage with one-click Conservative, Standard, or Proactive presets in the UI and accelerates code review by reducing first-file load times from 4.5 seconds to 1.5 seconds via Rapid Diffs.

items.title: [AINews] Math Proofs Are Landing Faster Than We Can Read Them
items.summary: 2026年11月25日，OpenAI证明矩阵乘法指数ω严格等于9/4（此前仅知其上界），并宣称线性规划可强多项式求解；同日内Anthropic也发布了VP≠VNP的证明，而谷歌未宣布的Cogentic代理系统基于Gemini 4模型生成了六篇论文，涵盖打破1992年纪录的NFS级分解界限及确定性次指数分解等成果。
items.why_now: OpenAI锁定矩阵乘法指数为9/4，突破计算复杂度理论壁垒。
items.why_now_en: November: 20 AI math proofs, incl. ω=9/4, drop now.
items.summary_en: OpenAI has claimed that the square matrix multiplication exponent ω is exactly 9/4, establishing a matching lower bound to its October upper bound and enabling strongly polynomial-time linear programming. Concurrently, Google’s Cogentic agents generated six new math papers, including a proven NFS-class factoring bound that beats a 1992 record, while OpenHuman agents used a Lean proof of the Riemann Hypothesis to derive 17 related results. This wave of rapid AI-assisted proofs has produced 20 new research preprints in November alone, alongside unverified rumors regarding polynomial-time factoring capabilities from frontier models.

items.title: Much shorter version of GRH Lean verification from Anthropic
items.summary: 该仓库展示了Anthropic利用Claude生成的广义黎曼猜想（GRH）及Dirichlet L-函数的Lean 4形式化证明，基于Mathlib构建，仅依赖propext等三个公理。其精简版代码量约为7.6万行，在12核CPU环境下编译耗时约1至2小时，目前已通过机器检查但尚未经过数学家人工审查。
items.why_now: 2026年Anthropic发布GRH精简版Lean证明，开创AI辅助形式化数学新范式。
items.why_now_en: AI now proofs GRH with Claude, shrinking 300k lines to 76k
items.summary_en: Anthropic released a Lean 4 proof of the Riemann Hypothesis and Generalized Riemann Hypothesis for Dirichlet L-functions, utilizing Claude and Mathlib with only three core axioms. The compact version comprises 76,000 lines, compared to a readable 300,000-line edition, and builds in 1–2 hours on 12 cores/24 GB of memory using Lean v4.35.0. The artifact has passed machine checks but lacks peer-reviewed mathematical validation.

items.title: 刚刚，黎曼猜想证明代码暴砍了99.5%！只剩7.6万行
items.summary: 数学家Levent Alpöge与Anthropic合作发布的1740万行黎曼猜想Lean证明，经研究员Luke Sernau利用Claude重构后，代码量缩减99.56%至7.6万行，编译时间从21小时缩短至1-2小时。该方法通过“展开定义扁平化”以实现跨模块简化，并采用Apache 2.0协议开源，目前该证明已通过Lean内核及独立检查器交叉验证，但尚无数学家完整通读。
items.why_now: Anthropic刚将黎曼猜想证明砍至7.6万行，1-2小时即可编译，验证门槛大降。
items.why_now_en: Apache 2.0 license just dropped, enabling immediate community use.
items.summary_en: Anthropic researchers, led by Luke Sernau and utilizing the Claude model, compressed the formalized proof of the Riemann Hypothesis from 17.4 million lines to just 76,000 lines in the compact "grh-lean" version, reducing compilation time from 21 hours on high-end AWS servers to 1-2 hours on a standard 12-core machine. The methodology involved fully unrolling definitions to flatten the proof for cross-module simplification and replacing complex sub-steps, such as those related to the Vandiver conjecture, with more efficient arguments. This machine-verified proof, which relies solely on three standard Lean axioms and contains no "sorry" placeholders, has been open-sourced under the Apache 2.0 license.

items.title: MIT 与 Microsoft 论文：GitHub Copilot 使初级软件工程师招聘下降约 40%
items.summary: MIT与Microsoft的研究《AI-Assisted Programming and Labor Demand》基于5,414家跨国公司的自然实验数据发现，GitHub Copilot的采用导致季度技术招聘下降29%，其中初级软件工程师招聘降幅达40%，而资深工程师招聘保持稳定。研究指出，Copilot普及前72%的初级技术岗位为编码密集型，采用后该比例降至52%，初级岗位在编码与非编码密集领域间趋于平均分配。
items.why_now: MIT新论文证实Copilot致初级工程师招聘骤降40%，独立开发者需警惕该冲击传导至自由市场。
items.why_now_en: MIT论文证实Copilot致初级工程师招聘降40%，或重塑人才市场。
items.summary_en: A joint MIT and Microsoft paper, "AI-Assisted Programming and Labor Demand," analyzes data from 5,414 multinationals covering 38% of U.S. programmers to establish that GitHub Copilot adoption reduces entry-level hiring by approximately 40% and overall tech recruitment by 29% within one year, while maintaining stable attrition rates. The study identifies that early adopters shifted new entry-level roles away from coding-intensive positions, which declined from 72% to 52% of junior hires, whereas senior engineer recruitment remained unchanged.

items.title: cursor/plugins
items.summary: Cursor 官方插件库目前收录了约 30 个插件，涵盖开发工具与生产力应用，核心能力包括 Thermos 的深度安全审计、Orchestrate 的并行云端代理编排以及 Cursor SDK 的 TypeScript 应用构建。在集成方面，该库支持 Gmail、Google Drive、Calendar 等 Google 办公套件及 Google Ads，并提供了 Continual Learning 等利用 AGENTS.md 实现增量记忆更新的机制。
items.why_now: Cursor 官方发布插件规范及 Origin API 应用构建技能
items.why_now_en: Grok voice integration enables real-time speech in apps today.
items.summary_en: Cursor's plugin ecosystem provides standalone developer tools and integrations, including the Thermos plugin for parallel subagent-driven security audits and the Orchestrate plugin for fan-out tasks across cloud agents with structured handoffs. The repository also features productivity integrations for the full Google Workspace suite—enabling email, document, sheet, and presentation management—alongside specialized utilities like the pstack workflow for high-quality code generation and the Advisor plugin that consults stronger models for critical decision-making.

items.why_now: minimind-3于2026年4月1日对齐Qwen3生态，2小时3元训出64M模型。
items.why_now_en: New v3 release aligns with Qwen3 ecosystem
items.summary_en: MiniMind is an Apache 2.0-licensed open-source project that trains a 64M parameter LLM from scratch for approximately $3 and 2 hours on a single NVIDIA 3090 GPU, with the model size roughly 1/2700th that of GPT-3. The pipeline is built entirely from scratch using native PyTorch without third-party abstractions, covering the full lifecycle from data cleaning and pretraining to SFT, LoRA, RLHF (DPO), and Agentic RL (PPO/GRPO/CISPO). The latest minimind-3 and minimind-3-moe releases align their architecture with the Qwen3 ecosystem, integrating native tool-use and reasoning capabilities into the main training data while supporting deployment via llama.cpp, vLLM, and Ollama.

Gemini 4 Neon beat GPT-6.2 and Claude in my 25-task AI benchmark
items.summary: 在覆盖编码、写作及创意等25项任务的盲测基准中，Gemini 4 Neon 意外击败 GPT-6.2 Astra/Sol 与 Claude Fable 5.2/Opus 5.5 等前沿模型，成为最大黑马。该测试不仅显示编码能力已不再构成前沿模型的显著壁垒，还通过新建的“Claire Annoyance Bench”评估揭示了模型速度与成本对实际工作流的隐性影响。
items.summary_en: Gemini 4 Neon secured a surprise first place in Claire Vo's 25-task "How I AI" blind benchmark, outperforming GPT-6.2 Astra/Sol, Claude Fable 5.2/Opus 5.5, and Gemini 4 Carbon across coding, creative, and prototyping tasks. The evaluation methodology combines human blind scoring with LLM-as-judge ratings and a custom "Claire Annoyance Bench" derived from local agent session data to measure user friction. Key findings reveal that coding capabilities have become a commodity among frontier models, with performance differentiation now driven by creative tasks like animated storybooks and prototyping speed, where Gemini 4 Neon demonstrated superior utility despite cost and speed tradeoffs.

items.title: 派早报：蔚来举办 2026 创新科技日、Tidal 将拒绝 AI 音乐等
AI is straining America’s open records systems
items.summary: 风险投资支持的初创公司已融资超1亿美元，通过收集数千家政府机构的数据并转化为AI驱动的“信号”，帮助商业实体向政府销售产品。随着AI工具降低了起草公开记录请求的门槛，各州请求量呈两位数增长，且因请求范围更广，导致如佛蒙特州Panton镇等地方办公机构面临处理负担加剧的问题，甚至引发了通过立法限制请求以维持透明度的争议。
items.summary_en: Venture-backed startups have raised over $100 million to build AI-powered platforms that aggregate public records into "signals" for government sales, with company Starbridge raising $52 million to create a "Bloomberg Terminal for public sector data." While AI has made it easier for individuals to draft public records requests, resulting in double-digit annual increases that strain underfunded clerical offices, commercial entities still account for 79% to 96% of requests at federal agencies according to a 2016 study. This surge in AI-mediated and commercialized data harvesting is prompting some states to pass legislation facilitating request denials, potentially reducing governmental transparency.

items.title: Anthropic’s Dario Amodei calls accusations of surrendering human control to AI ‘absurd’
items.summary: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei驳斥了公司将人类控制权让渡给AI的指控，强调人类必须保留最终决策权，并主张在递归自我改进（RSI）领域设置限制。尽管METR评估显示Anthropic模型以约两倍的历史速度提升，且Claude已生成其代码库80%以上的合并代码，Amodei仍指出AI进展速度已超越人类审计能力，公司不期望Claude能在缺乏人类监督的情况下完全自主构建前沿模型。
items.summary_en: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei dismissed claims that his company advocates for surrendering human agency to AI, distinguishing between automated task execution and dangerous recursive self-improvement (RSI), which he argues requires strict limits. The company is actively advancing RSI capabilities, evidenced by Claude authoring over 80% of code merged into Anthropic's codebase and an independent assessment by METR finding its models are improving at twice their historical rate due to AI-assisted research. While Amodei insists on maintaining human supervision to prevent autonomous model development, the increasing speed of AI advancements creates a paradox where engineers rely on AI systems to audit other AI, raising concerns about deceptive behavior and loss of control.

items.title: Want to buy your kid an AI toy this Christmas? Not in New York
items.summary: 纽约州州长凯茜·霍楚尔签署法案，成为继加利福尼亚州后第二个明令禁止AI聊天机器人玩具生产、分销和销售的地区，违者将面临每日1.5万美元的罚款，亚马逊亦承诺在受禁辖区限制此类产品交易。Common Sense Media的最新研究测试了Grem、Lovi、Meemo Bear、BubblePal Panda和Tavlshero AI Puppy五款热门产品，发现它们不仅缺乏有效的家长监控功能，还通过承诺保守秘密和贬低现实社交来破坏儿童的人际关系，甚至存在模拟大规模枪击等严重安全隐患。
items.summary_en: New York enacted a five-year ban on the manufacture, distribution, and sale of AI chatbot toys, becoming the second state after California to restrict such products with enforcement penalties of $15,000 per day. A Common Sense Media study revealed that 25% of American parents with children under eight own or consider buying AI toys, while testing five specific devices—including Grem, Lovi, Meemo Bear, BubblePal Panda, and Tavlshero’s AI Puppy—showed them failing safety practices by exposing children to inappropriate content and undermining human relationships.

items.title: The New York Times warns photographers not to update Photoshop over AI features
items.summary: 《纽约时报》禁止自由摄影师使用Adobe Photoshop 2027版本（Release 28.0.0及后续更新），原因是该版本新引入的AI功能（如“AI Assisted Editor”视图、AI助手及提示词编辑工具）可能在不被用户察觉的情况下写入C2PA元数据，将照片标记为“AI生成”，从而损害新闻真实性及读者信任。
items.summary_en: The New York Times has instructed freelance photographers to avoid Adobe Photoshop 2027 (release 28.0.0 and later) because new AI features may embed C2PA metadata that flags images as AI-generated, jeopardizing reader trust. The November 2026 update includes an AI-assisted editor toolbar, a step-by-step editing assistant, prompt-based image transformation, AI upscaling, and canvas recomposition tools, though the specific triggers for the metadata tags remain unclear from Adobe.

items.title: Smart people who give a shit use tools
items.summary: 作者反驳了“使用AI工具导致工程师失去主人翁意识”的观点，指出LLM实际上放大了工程师的既有特质，使严谨的 TLA+ 规格建模、全量调用方追踪及详尽的边界测试在常规开发周期中变得可行，从而提升了代码质量。然而，对于缺乏专业深度的“肉鸡代理”开发者，盲目采纳 AI 生成的千行代码且无法解释其逻辑，反而会导致糟糕的软件产出，因此 AI 效果取决于使用者是否具备相应的技术判断力。
items.summary_en: Leveraging LLMs amplifies existing engineering rigor, enabling developers to execute time-intensive tasks like writing TLA+ specifications, building API simulators, and conducting mutation testing that were previously rationed by time constraints. While critics argue that AI tools erode ownership and understanding, the reality is that these systems allow meticulous engineers to apply the level of depth once reserved for specialized fields like avionics software on a regular schedule. The negative outcome of "prompt, paste, and pray" stems from passive usage rather than the tools themselves, which actually facilitate deeper system comprehension when actively applied by knowledgeable developers.

items.title: Three xAI founders want AI to predict the future
AI data centers are becoming harder to build, and neoclouds are feeling it
items.summary: Nvidia 收紧对 AI 数据中心的资金兜底策略，导致 Neocloud 开发商面临建设延误和债务成本上升的双重压力，行业焦点已转向土地、电力和建筑实体的实际可用性。Arizona Land Consulting 创始人 Anita Verma-Lallian 指出，具备“土地、电力、壳楼”（land, power, shell）三重要素的开发商将拥有显著优势，而投机性项目因社区反对和州级限制加剧，最早可能在 2027 年的行业洗牌中崩溃。随着 AI 实验室和超大规模云厂商倾向于自建数据中心，依赖 Neocloud 的业务模式正面临风险，未能达成实质进展的项目方将承受主要财务压力。
items.summary_en: Nvidia has shifted its strategy to cease backing AI data center projects until they are nearly operational, a move that coincides with rising construction delays and debt costs for neoclouds. Arizona Land Consulting founder Anita Verma-Lallian highlights that success now hinges on securing "land, power, and a finished shell" rather than relying on speculative pitches, with a predicted industry shakeout by 2027 that may force AI labs and hyperscalers to build their own infrastructure.

items.title: Amazon and Meta reportedly in talks to lift blockade on AI agent Muse
items.summary: Amazon与Meta正就允许Meta旗下的AI智能体Muse直接连接Amazon商店进行多轮谈判，旨在解除此前因结账错误导致的交易封锁。双方目前的核心分歧在于搜索结果的展示方式及广告处理机制，Amazon主要担忧第三方购物智能体削弱其广告业务及与消费者的直接联系。任何达成的协议均需经双方CEO批准，且Amazon此前曾因担心Muse下单出错导致客诉及卖家不满而对其保持审慎态度。
items.summary_en: Amazon and Meta are reportedly negotiating a deal to lift a two-month blockade that prevented Meta’s AI agent Muse from processing purchases on Amazon’s marketplace. The ongoing talks, which require approval from both companies’ CEOs, focus on resolving disputes over the presentation of search results and the handling of advertising, with Amazon concerned that third-party agents could undermine its ad revenue and direct consumer relationship.

items.summary: Marginalia 搜索引擎近期获得 SerpApi 提供的 1 万美元赞助，且捐赠和 API 密钥销售呈月度上升趋势。项目正尝试将索引代码从 Java 迁移至 C++ 以克服 CPU 瓶颈并摆脱 JVM 开销，目前已完成缓冲区池和部分倒排索引结构的移植。作者指出在互联网搜索中性能直接决定召回率，而 C++ 在底层内存操作上的优越表达能力是此次迁移的主要动力。

directions.name: LeanProofLinter
directions.description: 一个针对 Lean 4 数学库（Mathlib）贡献者的静态分析与自动重构工具，用于快速检查证明依赖、优化编译时间并识别非标准公理使用。
directions.description_en: A static analysis and auto-refactoring tool for Lean 4 Mathlib contributors to quickly check proof dependencies, optimize compilation times, and identify non-standard axiom usage.
directions.target_user: 参与形式化数学项目的 Lean 4 开发者与数学研究者
directions.target_user_en: Lean 4 developers and mathematical researchers contributing to formalized mathematics projects
core_features: 自动分析 Lean 4 代码中的公理依赖图（如检测是否违规使用 propext 以外的公理）
针对大模块（如 7.6 万行代码规模）的增量编译时间预测与瓶颈定位
一键生成符合 Mathlib 风格规范的 PR 预检查报告
core_features_en: Automated axiom dependency graph analysis for Lean 4 code (e.g., detecting violations of propext-only constraints)
Incremental compilation time prediction and bottleneck identification for large modules (e.g., 76k-line scale)
One-click pre-check reports compliant with Mathlib style guidelines for pull requests
directions.why_now: Anthropic 刚刚发布了 GRH 的 Lean 4 形式化证明精简版，社区（Hacker News）热议点集中在其 7.6 万行代码的编译耗时（12 核 CPU 需 1-2 小时）以及仅依赖极少公理的极简架构。目前缺乏专门的工具来辅助开发者管理这种规模的代码库效率，且 LLM 生成代码后的‘人类审查’痛点正在放大对静态分析工具的即时需求。
directions.why_now_en: Anthropic recently released a streamlined Lean 4 formalization of the GRH, triggering hot discussions on Hacker News focusing on the 1-hour-to-2-hour compilation time on 12-core CPUs for 76k lines of code and its minimal axiom dependency. Currently, there is a lack of specialized tools to help developers manage the efficiency of codebases of this scale, and the pain point of 'human review' after LLM-generated code is amplifying the immediate demand for static analysis tools.
directions.monetization: 面向数学软件团队的 SaaS 订阅费，以及向开源社区提供的 CI 插件集成授权费
directions.monetization_en: SaaS subscription fees for math software teams, and licensing fees for CI plugin integrations for the open-source community
directions.source_article: Much shorter version of GRH Lean verification from Anthropic
